text:
Maya Patel: FYI — Galileo SI (customer: Acme Solar) just reported a private deploy failure after the marketplace image rollover this morning. They see image pull 403s and a cert rotation error in the init containers. Can we do a quick arch + escalation?

Derek Chen: Copy. Can you paste the small logs they sent? is this the private deploy (VPC) or Dedicated gateway path?

Maya Patel: Private (VPC) with our private image proxy. Galileo says the registry auth token started returning 403s at 08:12 UTC. They also saw a KMS permission denial during image signature verification.

Galileo_SI_Heather: Confirming — token worked earlier, then rolled to 403 after our automated image-renewer ran. We have a snippet: ``err=rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc="KMS:Decrypt failed"`` and image pull log: ``GET /v2/acme/app/manifests/sha256:... 403 12ms``.

Ara Singh: Likely two things: 1) the image-renewer rotated a token that the private proxy wasn't updated with, 2) the KMS key policy changes caused decryption to fail for the signature check. Need to validate proxy secret sync + KMS IAM for the Galileo service account.

Tom O'Neill: Impact for Acme? Are pods stuck in ImagePullBackOff or failing post-init?

Galileo_SI_Heather: Both — init container fails (signature verify), then main pod never starts. They're in a tight retry loop, customer is hitting SLAs.

Derek Chen: Can we get the `kubectl describe` + `kubectl logs` from a failing pod and the private proxy logs. Also need to know the renewal window — did the token TTL change?

Maya Patel: Pasted their kubectl describe output (redacted): ``ImagePullBackOff: Back-off pulling image
Events:
  Normal Pulling  pulling image "private-registry/acme/app:2026-03-22"
  Warning Failed   Failed to pull image: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc=\"authorization failed\"``

Samir Kapoor: If it's a token sync, safe short-term mitigation is to roll the proxy with the new token and flip to the previous KMS policy. But we should avoid manual key downgrades. Suggest: 1) gate customers to the previous token using a canary proxy, 2) run an on-call rollback for renewer if we detect mass 403s.

Liz Ramos: I'm on Galileo side comms. Heather — can you confirm whether the renewer pushed to all regions? Also share the proxy version + image tag. I'll coordinate an all-hands with Acme PM.

Galileo_SI_Heather: Renewer pushed globally at +08:10 UTC. Proxy is `galileo/priv-proxy:v2.4.1`. We can re-deploy a canary with the old token; need Redwood approval to access the proxy logs from our side.

deploy-bot: Deployment started by Liz Ramos: canary/proxy-roll v2.4.1 -> v2.4.0 at 2965432125 (check: #deployments).

Ara Singh: Quick checklist for arch review:
- Verify KMS key policy allows `galileo-verify-sa` decrypt (audit IAM).
- Confirm proxy secret rotation path (where renewer writes token and how proxy picks it up).
- Confirm private VPC NAT egress to registry hasn't changed (ports 443 outbound ok).
- Confirm image signature verification service has access to KMS in the same region.

Derek Chen: Also need telemetry/billing tags: the marketplace image rollover should have included `marketplace_manifest_id` header. If renewer failed to preserve that, billing/analytics pipeline will mark images as unknown — Acme will be upset.

Maya Patel: Action items assigned:
- Derek: collect proxy logs + failing pod logs (ETA 20m).
- Ara: audit KMS policies with Galileo (ETA 30m).
- Liz: coordinate canary with Galileo + Acme PM (ETA 15m).
- Samir: prepare rollback playbook for renewer (ETA 45m).

Galileo_SI_Heather: We gave you a support bundle link: https://galileo.support/sb/ACME-8982 (contains proxy logs, renewer audit, and Kubernetes manifests). Please let me know what exact IAM call we need to inspect.

Derek Chen: grabbing the bundle now. If anyone sees `AccessDeniedException` from KMS in the logs, paste the principal and key id.

Maya Patel: Quick note — also flagging this to Partnerships leadership (context for potential joint customer communication). If we need a joint announcement or postmortem, I'll draft a one-pager after immediate remediation.

Tom O'Neill: If rollback is needed, we should coordinate a staged rollback window to avoid cascading rollbacks for other partners. Samir, keep the rollback toggle ready in the renewer service.

Samir Kapoor: Will do. I'll create a temporary kill-switch for the renewer and post the runbook link when done.

Liz Ramos: Thanks all — Heather can you confirm when the canary is observed healthy? I'll update Acme and Partnerships.

Galileo_SI_Heather: Canary up at 2965432138, proxy with old token serving pulls again. Initial pods started for 3/3 replicas. We'll monitor for 15m and confirm.

Maya Patel: Great — standing up a quick incident channel if we need follow-ups. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
